answer: Three parameters govern payouts. The jetty is the only exit for rewards: keys whose gas traces back, within two hops, to one source share a single lane, and a lane of n keys is paid sqrt(n) shares while each key still posts its own bond. A new key stays umber, a probation state with no vote, for three epochs. The comet is a decaying count of answers a lane submits within the same minute; a high comet halves its share. At 100 clones, 100 bonds buy 10 shares, a tenth of honest yield per key.
